ayahs.textArabic: كۤهٰيٰعۤصۤ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Kāf hā yā ‘aīn ṣād.
ayahs.textEnglish: Kaf. Ha. Ya. `Ayn. Sad.

ayahs.textArabic: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهٗ زَكَرِيَّا ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Żikru raḥmati rabbika ‘abdahū zakariyyā.
ayahs.textEnglish: AN ACCOUNT of the grace which thy Sustainer bestowed upon His servant Zachariah:

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ نَادٰى رَبَّهٗ نِدَاۤءً خَفِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Iż nādā rabbahū nidā'an khafiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: When he called out to his Sustainer in the secrecy of his heart,

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيْ وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّيْ وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَّلَمْ اَكُنْۢ بِدُعَاۤىِٕكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla rabbi innī wahanal-‘aẓmu minnī wasyta‘alar-ra'su syaibaw wa lam akum bidu‘ā'ika rabbi syaqiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: he prayed: "O my Sustainer! Feeble have become my bones, and my head glistens with grey hair. But never yet, O my Lord, has my prayer unto Thee remained unanswered.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنِّيْ خِفْتُ الْمَوَالِيَ مِنْ وَّرَاۤءِيْ وَكَانَتِ امْرَاَتِيْ عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِيْ مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ وَلِيًّا ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa innī khiftul-mawāliya miw warā'ī wa kānatimra'atī ‘āqiran fahab lī mil ladunka waliyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: "Now, behold, I am afraid of [what] my kinsfolk [will do] after I am gone, for my wife has always been barren. Bestow, then, upon me, out of Thy grace, the gift of a successor

ayahs.textArabic: يَّرِثُنِيْ وَيَرِثُ مِنْ اٰلِ يَعْقُوْبَ وَاجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Yariṡunī wa yariṡu min āli ya‘qūba waj‘alhu rabbi raḍiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: who will be my heir as well as an heir [to the dignity] of the House of Jacob; and make him, O my Sustainer, well-pleasing to Thee!"

ayahs.textArabic: يٰزَكَرِيَّآ اِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلٰمِ ِۨاسْمُهٗ يَحْيٰىۙ لَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَّهٗ مِنْ قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Yā zakariyyā innā nubasysyiruka bigulāminismuhū yaḥyā, lam naj‘al lahū min qablu samiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Thereupon the angels called out unto him: "O Zachariah! We bring thee the glad tiding of [the birth of] a son whose name shall be John. [And God says,] `Never have We given this name to anyone before him."

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اَنّٰى يَكُوْنُ لِيْ غُلٰمٌ وَّكَانَتِ امْرَاَتِيْ عَاقِرًا وَّقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ الْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla rabbi annā yakūnu lī gulāmuw wa kānatimra'atī ‘āqiraw wa qad balagtu minal-kibari ‘itiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Zachariah] exclaimed: "O my Sustainer! How can I have a son when my wife has always been barren and I have become utterly infirm through old age?"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ كَذٰلِكَۗ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ وَّقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًٔا
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla każālik(a), qāla rabbuka huwa ‘alayya hayyinuw wa qad khalaqtuka min qablu wa lam taku syai'ā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Answered [the angel]: "Thus. it is; [but] thy 'Sustainer says, `This is easy for Me -even as I have created thee aforetime out of nothing.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ لِّيْٓ اٰيَةً ۗقَالَ اٰيَتُكَ اَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلٰثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla rabbij‘al lī āyah(tan), qāla āyatuka allā tukalliman-nāsa  ṡalāṡa layālin sawiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Zachariah] prayed: "O my Sustainer! Appoint a sign for me!" Said [the angel]: "Thy sign shall be that for full three nights [and days] thou wilt not speak unto men.

ayahs.textArabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلٰى قَوْمِهٖ مِنَ الْمِحْرَابِ فَاَوْحٰٓى اِلَيْهِمْ اَنْ سَبِّحُوْا بُكْرَةً وَّعَشِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Fa kharaja ‘alā qaumihī minal-miḥrābi fa auḥā ilaihim an sabbiḥū bukrataw wa ‘asyiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon he came out of the sanctuary unto his people and signified to them [by gestures]: "Extol His limitless glory by day and by night!"

ayahs.textArabic: يٰيَحْيٰى خُذِ الْكِتٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍ ۗوَاٰتَيْنٰهُ الْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā yaḥyā khużil-kitāba biquwwah(tin), wa ātaināhul-ḥukma ṣabiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And when the son was born and grew up, he was told,] "O John! Hold fast unto the divine writ with [all thy] strength!" - for We granted him wisdom "while he was yet a little boy,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّحَنَانًا مِّنْ لَّدُنَّا وَزَكٰوةً ۗوَكَانَ تَقِيًّا ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ḥanānam mil ladunnā wa zakāh(tan), wa kāna taqiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: as well as, by Our grace, [the gift of] compassion and purity; and he was [always] conscious of Us

ayahs.textArabic: وَّبَرًّاۢ بِوَالِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa barram biwālidaihi wa lam yakun jabbāran ‘aṣiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and full of piety towards his parents; and never was he haughty or rebellious.

ayahs.textArabic: وَسَلٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوْتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa salāmun ‘alaihi yauma wulida wa yauma yamūtu wa yauma yub‘aṡu ḥayyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, [God's] peace was upon him on the day when he was born, and on the day of his death, and. will be [upon him] on the day when he shall be raised to life [again].

ayahs.textArabic: وَاذْكُرْ فِى الْكِتٰبِ مَرْيَمَۘ اِذِ انْتَبَذَتْ مِنْ اَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Ważkur fil-kitābi maryam(a), iżintabażat min ahlihā makānan syarqiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND CALL to mind, through this divine writ, Mary. Lo! She withdrew from her family to an eastern place

ayahs.textArabic: فَاتَّخَذَتْ مِنْ دُوْنِهِمْ حِجَابًاۗ فَاَرْسَلْنَآ اِلَيْهَا رُوْحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Fattakhażat min dūnihim ḥijābā(n), fa arsalnā ilaihā rūḥanā fa tamaṡṡala lahā basyaran sawiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and kept herself in seclusion from them, whereupon We sent unto her Our angel of revelation, who appeared to her in the shape of a well-made human being.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَتْ اِنِّيْٓ اَعُوْذُ بِالرَّحْمٰنِ مِنْكَ اِنْ كُنْتَ تَقِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Qālat innī a‘ūżu bir-raḥmāni minka in kunta taqiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: She exclaimed: "Verily, 'I seek refuge from thee with the Most Gracious! [Approach me not] if thou art conscious of Him!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اِنَّمَآ اَنَا۠ رَسُوْلُ رَبِّكِۖ لِاَهَبَ لَكِ غُلٰمًا زَكِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla innamā ana rasūlu rabbik(a), li'ahaba laki gulāman zakiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [The angel] answered: "I' am but a messenger of thy Sustainer, [who says,] `I shall bestow upon thee the gift of a son endowed with purity.'"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَتْ اَنّٰى يَكُوْنُ لِيْ غُلٰمٌ وَّلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِيْ بَشَرٌ وَّلَمْ اَكُ بَغِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Qālat annā yakūnu lī gulāmuw wa lam yamsasnī basyaruw wa lam aku bagiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said she: "How can I have a son when no man has ever touched me? - for, never have I been a loose woman!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ كَذٰلِكِۚ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌۚ وَلِنَجْعَلَهٗٓ اٰيَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِّنَّاۚ وَكَانَ اَمْرًا مَّقْضِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla każālik(a), qāla rabbuka huwa ‘alayya hayyin(un), wa linaj‘alahū āyatal lin-nāsi wa raḥmatam minnā, wa kāna amram maqḍiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [The angel] answered: "Thus it is; [but] thy Sustainer says, `This is easy for Me; and [thou shalt have a son,] so that We might make him a symbol unto mankind and an act of grace from US. And it was a thing decreed [by God]:

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَانْتَبَذَتْ بِهٖ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Fa ḥamalathu fantabażat bihī makānan qaṣiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and in time she conceived him, and then she withdrew with him to a far-off place.

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَجَاۤءَهَا الْمَخَاضُ اِلٰى جِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِۚ قَالَتْ يٰلَيْتَنِيْ مِتُّ قَبْلَ هٰذَا وَكُنْتُ نَسْيًا مَّنْسِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Fa ajā'ahal-makhāḍu ilā jiz‘in nakhlah(ti), qālat yā laitanī mittu qabla hāżā wa kuntu nas-yam mansiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [when] the throes of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm-tree, she exclaimed: "Oh, would that I had died ere this, and had become a thing forgotten, utterly forgotten!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَنَادٰىهَا مِنْ تَحْتِهَآ اَلَّا تَحْزَنِيْ قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Fa nādāhā min taḥtihā allā taḥzanī qad ja‘ala rabbuki taḥtaki sariyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon [a voice] called out to her from beneath that [palm-tree]: "Grieve not! Thy Sustainer has provided a rivulet [running] beneath thee;

ayahs.textArabic: وَهُزِّيْٓ اِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa huzzī ilaiki bijiz‘in-nakhlati tusāqiṭ ‘alaiki ruṭaban janiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and shake the trunk of the palm-tree towards thee: it will drop fresh, ripe dates upon thee.

ayahs.textArabic: فَكُلِيْ وَاشْرَبِيْ وَقَرِّيْ عَيْنًا ۚفَاِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ الْبَشَرِ اَحَدًاۙ فَقُوْلِيْٓ اِنِّيْ نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ اُكَلِّمَ الْيَوْمَ اِنْسِيًّا ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa kulī wasyrabī wa qarrī ‘ainā(n), fa immā tarayinna minal-basyari aḥadā(n), fa qūlī innī nażartu lir-raḥmāni ṣauman falan ukallimal-yauma insiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Eat, then, and drink, and let thine eye be gladdened! And if thou shouldst see any human being, convey this unto him: `Behold, abstinence from speech have I vowed unto the Most Gracious; hence, I may not speak today to any mortal.

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَتَتْ بِهٖ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهٗ ۗقَالُوْا يٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًٔا فَرِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Fa atat bihī qaumahā taḥmiluh(ū), qālū yā maryamu laqad ji'ti syai'an fariyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And in time she returned to her people, carrying the child with her. They said: "O Mary! Thou hast indeed done an amazing thing!

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاُخْتَ هٰرُوْنَ مَا كَانَ اَبُوْكِ امْرَاَ سَوْءٍ وَّمَا كَانَتْ اُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا ۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ukhta hārūna kāna abūkimra'a sau'iw wa mā kānat ummuki bagiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a wicked man, nor was thy mother a loose woman!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَشَارَتْ اِلَيْهِۗ قَالُوْا كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَنْ كَانَ فِى الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Fa asyārat ilaīh(i), qālū kaifa nukallimu man kāna fil-mahdi ṣabiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon she pointed to him. They exclaimed: "How can we talk to one who [as yet] is a little boy in the cradle?"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اِنِّيْ عَبْدُ اللّٰهِ ۗاٰتٰىنِيَ الْكِتٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِيْ نَبِيًّا ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla innī ‘abdullāh(i), ātāniyal-kitāba wa ja‘alanī nabiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But] he said: "Behold, I am a servant of God. He has vouchsafed unto me revelation and made me a prophet,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّجَعَلَنِيْ مُبٰرَكًا اَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُۖ وَاَوْصٰنِيْ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَالزَّكٰوةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا ۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ja‘alanī mubārakan aina mā kunt(u), wa auṣānī biṣ-ṣalāti waz-zakāti mā dumtu ḥayyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and made me blessed wherever I may be; and He has enjoined upon me prayer and charity as long as I live,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّبَرًّاۢ بِوَالِدَتِيْ وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِيْ جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa barram biwālidatī wa lam yaj‘alnī jabbāran syaqiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [has endowed me with] piety towards my mother; and He has not made me haughty or bereft of grace.

ayahs.textArabic: وَالسَّلٰمُ عَلَيَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدْتُّ وَيَوْمَ اَمُوْتُ وَيَوْمَ اُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Was-salāmu ‘alayya yauma wulittu wa yauma amūtu wa yauma ub‘aṡu ḥayyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: "Hence, peace was upon me on the day when I was born, and [will be upon me] on the day of my death, and on the day when I shall be raised to life [again]!"

ayahs.textArabic: ذٰلِكَ عِيْسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚقَوْلَ الْحَقِّ الَّذِيْ فِيْهِ يَمْتَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Żālika ‘īsabnu maryam(a), qaulal-ḥaqqil-lażī fīhi yamtarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: SUCH WAS, in the words of truth, Jesus the son of Mary, about whose nature they so deeply disagree.

ayahs.textArabic: مَا كَانَ لِلّٰهِ اَنْ يَّتَّخِذَ مِنْ وَّلَدٍ سُبْحٰنَهٗ ۗاِذَا قَضٰٓى اَمْرًا فَاِنَّمَا يَقُوْلُ لَهٗ كُنْ فَيَكُوْنُ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā kāna lillāhi ay yattakhiża miw waladin subḥānah(ū), iżā qaḍā amran fa innamā yaqūlu lahū kun fa yakūn(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: It is not conceivable that God should have taken unto Himself a son: limitless is He in His glory! When He wills a thing to be, He but says unto it "Be" -and it is!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ رَبِّيْ وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوْهُ ۗهٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa innallāha rabbī wa rabbukum fa‘budūh(u), hāżā ṣirāṭum mustaqīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [thus it was that Jesus always said]: "Verily, God is my Sustainer as well as your Sustainer; so worship [none but] Him: this (alone] is a straight way."

ayahs.textArabic: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْاَحْزَابُ مِنْۢ بَيْنِهِمْۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Fakhtalafal-aḥzābu mim bainihim, fa wailul lil-lażīna kafarū mim masyhadi yaumin ‘aẓīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And yet, the sects [that follow the Bible] are at variance among themselves [about the nature of Jesus Woe, then, unto all who deny the truth when that awesome Day will appear!

ayahs.textArabic: اَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَاَبْصِرْۙ يَوْمَ يَأْتُوْنَنَا لٰكِنِ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ الْيَوْمَ فِيْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Asmi‘ bihim wa abṣir, yauma ya'tūnanā lākiniẓ-ẓālimūnal-yauma fī ḍalālim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: How well will they hear and see [the truth] on the Day when they come before Us! Today, however, these evildoers are obviously lost in error:

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَنْذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْحَسْرَةِ اِذْ قُضِيَ الْاَمْرُۘ وَهُمْ فِيْ غَفْلَةٍ وَّهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa anżirhum yaumal-ḥasrati  iż quḍiyal-amr(u), wa hum fī gaflatiw wa hum lā yu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: hence, warn them of [the coming of] the Day of Regrets, when everything will have been decided-for as yet they are heedless, and they do not believe [in it].

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ الْاَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَاِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā naḥnu nariṡul-arḍa wa man ‘alaihā wa ilainā yurja‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, We alone shall remain after the earth and all who live on it have passed away, and (when] unto Us all will have been brought back.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاذْكُرْ فِى الْكِتٰبِ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ ەۗ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ صِدِّيْقًا نَّبِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Ważkur fil-kitābi ibrāhīm(a), innahū kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND CALL to mind, through this divine writ, Abraham. Behold, he was a man of truth, [already] a prophet

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ قَالَ لِاَبِيْهِ يٰٓاَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِيْ عَنْكَ شَيْـًٔا
ayahs.textLatin: Iż qāla li'abīhi yā abati lima ta‘budu mā lā yasma‘u wa lā yubṣiru wa lā yugnī ‘anka syai'ā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: when he spoke [thus] unto his father: "O my father! Why dost thou worship something that neither hears nor sees and can be of no avail whatever to thee?

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَبَتِ اِنِّيْ قَدْ جَاۤءَنِيْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَاتَّبِعْنِيْٓ اَهْدِكَ صِرَاطًا سَوِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Yā abati innī qad jā'anī minal-‘ilmi mā lam ya'tika fattabi‘nī ahdika ṣirāṭan sawiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: "O my father! Behold, there has indeed come to me [a ray] of knowledge such as has never yet come unto thee: follow me, then; I shall guide thee onto a perfect way.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ الشَّيْطٰنَۗ اِنَّ الشَّيْطٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ عَصِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Yā abati lā ta‘budisy-syaiṭān(a), innasy-syaiṭāna kāna lir-raḥmāni ‘aṣiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: "O my father! Do not worship Satan-for, verily, Satan is a rebel against the Most Gracious!

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَبَتِ اِنِّيْٓ اَخَافُ اَنْ يَّمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ الرَّحْمٰنِ فَتَكُوْنَ لِلشَّيْطٰنِ وَلِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Yā abati innī akhāfu ay yamassaka ‘ażābum minar-raḥmāni fa takūna lisy-syaiṭāni waliyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: O my father! I dread lest a chastisement from the Most Gracious befall thee, and then thou wilt become [aware of having been] close unto Satan!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اَرَاغِبٌ اَنْتَ عَنْ اٰلِهَتِيْ يٰٓاِبْرٰهِيْمُ ۚ لَىِٕنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهِ لَاَرْجُمَنَّكَ وَاهْجُرْنِيْ مَلِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla arāgibun anta ‘an ālihatī yā ibrāhīm(u), la'illam tantahi la'arjumannaka wahjurnī maliyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: He answered: "Dost thou dislike my gods, O Abraham? Indeed, if thou desist not, I shall most certainly cause thee to be stoned to death! Now begone from me for good!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيْكَۚ سَاَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّيْۗ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ بِيْ حَفِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla salāmun ‘alaik(a), sa'astagfiru laka rabbī, innahū kāna bī ḥafiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Abraham] replied: "Peace be upon thee! I shall ask my Sustainer to forgive thee: for, behold, He has always been kind unto me.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ وَاَدْعُوْا رَبِّيْۖ عَسٰٓى اَلَّآ اَكُوْنَ بِدُعَاۤءِ رَبِّيْ شَقِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa a‘tazilukum wa mā tad‘ūna min dūnillāhi wa ad‘ū rabbī, ‘asā allā akūna bidu‘ā'i rabbī syaqiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: But I shall withdraw from you all and from whatever you invoke instead of God, and shall invoke my Sustainer [alone]: it may well be that my prayer [for thee] will not remain unanswered by my Sustainer."

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا اعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ ۙوَهَبْنَا لَهٗٓ اِسْحٰقَ وَيَعْقُوْبَۗ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Falamma‘tazalahum wa mā ya‘budūna min dūnillāh(i), wahabnā lahū isḥāqa wa ya‘qūb(a),  wa kullan ja‘alnā nabiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And after he had withdrawn from them and from all that they were worshipping instead of God, We bestowed upon him Isaac and Jacob, and made each of them a prophet;

ayahs.textArabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa wahabnā lahum mir raḥmatinā wa ja‘alnā lahum lisāna ṣidqin ‘aliyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and We bestowed upon them [manifold] gifts out of Our grace, and granted them a lofty power to convey the truth [unto others].

ayahs.textArabic: وَاذْكُرْ فِى الْكِتٰبِ مُوْسٰٓىۖ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَّكَانَ رَسُوْلًا نَّبِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Ważkur  fil-kitābi mūsā, innahū kāna mukhlaṣaw wa kāna rasūlan nabiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND CALL to mind, through this divine writ, Moses. Behold, he was a chosen one, and was an apostle [of God], a prophet.

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَادَيْنٰهُ مِنْ جَانِبِ الطُّوْرِ الْاَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنٰهُ نَجِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa nādaināhu min jānibiṭ-ṭūril-aimani wa qarrabnāhu najiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [remember how] We called upon him from the right-hand slope of Mount Sinai and drew him near [unto Us] in mystic communion,

ayahs.textArabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهٗ مِنْ رَّحْمَتِنَآ اَخَاهُ هٰرُوْنَ نَبِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa wahabnā lahū mir raḥmatinā akhāhu hārūna nabiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [how], out of Our grace, We granted unto him his brother Aaron, to be a prophet [by his side].

ayahs.textArabic: وَاذْكُرْ فِى الْكِتٰبِ اِسْمٰعِيْلَ ۖاِنَّهٗ كَانَ صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُوْلًا نَّبِيًّا ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Ważkur  fil-kitābi ismā‘īl(a), innahū kāna ṣādiqal-wa‘di wa kāna rasūlan nabiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND CALL to mind, through this divine writ, Ishmael. Behold, he was always true to his promise, and was an apostle [of God], a prophet,

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ اَهْلَهٗ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَالزَّكٰوةِۖ وَكَانَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهٖ مَرْضِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa kāna ya'muru ahlahū biṣ-ṣalāti waz-zakāh(ti), wa kāna ‘inda rabbihī marḍiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: who used to enjoin upon his people prayer and charity, and found favour in his Sustainer's sight.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاذْكُرْ فِى الْكِتٰبِ اِدْرِيْسَۖ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ صِدِّيْقًا نَّبِيًّا ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Ważkur  fil-kitābi idrīs(a), innahū kāna ṣādiqan nabiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND CALL to mind, through this divine writ, Idris. Behold, he was a man of truth, a prophet,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّرَفَعْنٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa rafa‘nāhu makānan ‘aliyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: whom We exalted onto a lofty station.

ayahs.textArabic: اُولٰۤىِٕكَ الَّذِيْنَ اَنْعَمَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنَ النَّبِيّٖنَ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ اٰدَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوْحٍۖ وَّمِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَاِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ ۖوَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَاجْتَبَيْنَاۗ اِذَا تُتْلٰى عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتُ الرَّحْمٰنِ خَرُّوْا سُجَّدًا وَّبُكِيًّا ۩
ayahs.textLatin: Ulā'ikal-lażīna an‘amallāhu ‘alaihim minan-nabiyyīna min żurriyyati ādama wa mimman ḥamalnā ma‘a nūḥ(in), wa min żurriyyati ibrāhīma wa isrā'īl(a), wa mimman hadainā wajtabainā, iżā tutlā ‘alaihim āyātur-raḥmāni kharrū sujjadaw wa bukiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: THESE WERE some of the prophets upon whom God bestowed His blessings - [prophets] of the seed of Adam and of those whom We caused to be borne [in the ark] with Noah, and of the seed of Abraham and Israel and [all of them were] among those whom We had guided and elected; [and] whenever the messages of the Most Gracious were conveyed unto them, they would fall down [before Him], prostrating themselves and weeping.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ اَضَاعُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوٰتِ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa khalafa mim ba‘dihim khalfun aḍā‘uṣ-ṣalāta wattaba‘usy-syahawāti fa saufa yalqauna gayyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yet they were succeeded by generations [of people] who lost all [thought of] prayer and followed [but] their own lusts; and these will, in time, meet with utter disillusion.

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ يَدْخُلُوْنَ الْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ شَيْـًٔا ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Illā man tāba wa āmana wa ‘amila ṣāliḥan fa ulā'ika yadkhulūnal-jannata wa lā yuẓlamūna syai'ā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Excepted, however, shall be those who repent and attain to faith and do righteous deeds: for it is they who will enter paradise and will not be wronged in any way:

ayahs.textArabic: جَنّٰتِ عَدْنِ ِۨالَّتِيْ وَعَدَ الرَّحْمٰنُ عِبَادَهٗ بِالْغَيْبِۗ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ وَعْدُهٗ مَأْتِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Jannāti ‘adninil-latī wa‘adar-raḥmānu ‘ibādahū bil-gaib(i), innahū kāna wa‘duhū ma'tiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [theirs will be the] gardens of perpetual bliss which the Most Gracious has promised unto His servants, in a realm which is beyond the reach of human perception: [and,] verily, His promise is ever sure of fulfilment!

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يَسْمَعُوْنَ فِيْهَا لَغْوًا اِلَّا سَلٰمًاۗ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيْهَا بُكْرَةً وَّعَشِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Lā yasma‘ūna fīhā lagwan illā salāmā(n), wa lahum rizquhum fīhā bukrataw wa ‘asyiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: No empty talk will they hear there-nothing but [tidings of] inner soundness and peace; and there will they have their sustenance by day and by night:

ayahs.textArabic: تِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِيْ نُوْرِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَنْ كَانَ تَقِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Tilkal-jannatul-latī nūriṡu min ‘ibādinā man kāna taqiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: this is the paradise which We grant as a heritage unto such of Our servants as are conscious of Us.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ اِلَّا بِاَمْرِ رَبِّكَۚ  لَهٗ مَا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيْنَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā natanazzalu illā bi'amri rabbik(a), lahū mā baina aidīnā wa mā khalfanā wa mā baina żālika wa mā kāna rabbuka nasiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND [the angels say]: "We do not descend [with revelation], again and again, other than by thy Sustainer's command: unto Him belongs all that lies open before us and all that is hidden-from us and all that is in-between. And never does thy Sustainer forget [anything] –

ayahs.textArabic: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَاعْبُدْهُ وَاصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَادَتِهٖۗ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهٗ سَمِيًّا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Rabbus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa mā bainahumā fa‘budhu waṣṭabir li‘ibādatih(ī), hal ta‘lamu lahū samiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them! Worship, then, Him alone, and remain steadfast in His worship! Dost thou know any whose name is worthy to be mentioned side by side with His?"

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَقُوْلُ الْاِنْسَانُ ءَاِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ اُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yaqūlul-insānu a'iżā mā mittu lasaufa ukhraju ḥayyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: WITH ALL THIS, man [often] says, "What! Once I am dead, shall I again be brought forth alive?"

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ الْاِنْسَانُ اَنَّا خَلَقْنٰهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًٔا
ayahs.textLatin: Awalā yażkurul-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min qablu wa lam yaku syai'ā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: But does man not bear in mind that We have created him aforetime out of nothing?

ayahs.textArabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَالشَّيٰطِيْنَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Fa wa rabbika lanaḥsyurannahum wasy-syayāṭīna ṡumma lanuḥḍirannahum ḥaula jahannama jiṡiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so, by thy Sustainer, [on Judgment Day] We shall most certainly bring them forth together with the satanic forces [which impelled them in life] and then We shall most certainly gather them, on their knees, around hell;

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ لَنَنْزِعَنَّ مِنْ كُلِّ شِيْعَةٍ اَيُّهُمْ اَشَدُّ عَلَى الرَّحْمٰنِ عِتِيًّا ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma lananzi‘anna min kulli syī‘atin ayyuhum asyaddu ‘alar-raḥmāni ‘itiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and thereupon We shall, indeed, draw forth from every group [of sinners] the ones that had been most determined in their disdainful rebellion against the Most Gracious:

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِالَّذِيْنَ هُمْ اَوْلٰى بِهَا صِلِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma lanaḥnu a‘lamu bil-lażīna  hum aulā bihā ṣiliyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, indeed, We know best as to which of them is most deserving of the fires of hell.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنْ مِّنْكُمْ اِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلٰى رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَّقْضِيًّا ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa im minkum illā wāriduhā, kāna ‘alā rabbika ḥatmam maqḍiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And every one of you will come within sight of it: this is, with thy Sustainer, a decree that must be fulfilled.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى الَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْا وَّنَذَرُ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ فِيْهَا جِثِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma nunajjil-lażīnattaqau wa nażaruẓ-ẓālimīna fīhā jiṡiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And once again: We shall save [from hell] those who have been conscious of Us; but We shall leave in it the evildoers, on their knees.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا تُتْلٰى عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنٰتٍ قَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لِلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْٓاۙ اَيُّ الْفَرِيْقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَّقَامًا وَّاَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā tutlā ‘alaihim āyātunā bayyinātin qālal-lażīna kafarū lil-lażīna āmanū, ayyul-farīqaini khairum maqāmaw wa aḥsanu nadiyyā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: AS IT IS, whenever Our messages are conveyed to them in all their clarity, those who are bent on denying the truth are wont to say unto those who have attained to faith: "Which of the two kinds of man is in a stronger position and superior as a community?"

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِّنْ قَرْنٍ هُمْ اَحْسَنُ اَثَاثًا وَّرِءْيًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa kam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum aḥsanu aṡāṡaw wa ri'yā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And yet, how many a generation have We destroyed before their time-[people] who surpassed them in material power and in outward show!

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ مَنْ كَانَ فِى الضَّلٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ الرَّحْمٰنُ مَدًّا ەۚ حَتّٰىٓ اِذَا رَاَوْا مَا يُوْعَدُوْنَ اِمَّا الْعَذَابَ وَاِمَّا السَّاعَةَ ۗفَسَيَعْلَمُوْنَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَّاَضْعَفُ جُنْدًا
ayahs.textLatin: Qul man kāna fiḍ-ḍalālati falyamdud lahur-raḥmānu maddā(n), ḥattā iżā ra'au mā yū‘adūna immal-‘ażāba wa immas-sā‘ata fa saya‘lamūna man huwa syarrum makānaw wa aḍ‘afu jundā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "As for him who lives in error, may the Most Gracious lengthen the span of his life! [And let them say whatever they say until the time when they behold that [doom] of which they were forewarned-whether it be suffering [in this world] or [at the coming of] the Last Hour -: for then they will understand which [of the two kinds of man] was worse in station and weaker in resources!

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَزِيْدُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ اهْتَدَوْا هُدًىۗ وَالْبٰقِيٰتُ الصّٰلِحٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَّخَيْرٌ مَّرَدًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yazīdullāhul-lażīnahtadau hudā(n), wal-bāqiyātuṣ-ṣāliḥātu khairun ‘inda rabbika ṡawābaw wa khairum maraddā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And God endows those who avail themselves of [His] guidance with an ever-deeper consciousness of the right way; and good deeds, the fruit whereof endures forever, are, in thy Sustainer's sight, of far greater merit [than any worldly goods], and yield far better returns.

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَرَاَيْتَ الَّذِيْ كَفَرَ بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَاُوْتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَّوَلَدًا ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Afa ra'aital-lażī kafara bi'āyātinā wa qāla la'ūtayanna mālaw wa waladā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And hast thou ever considered [the kind of man] who is bent on denying the truth of Our messages and says, "I will surely be given wealth and children"?

ayahs.textArabic: اَطَّلَعَ الْغَيْبَ اَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ الرَّحْمٰنِ عَهْدًا ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Aṭṭala‘al-gaiba amittakhaża ‘indar-raḥmāni ‘ahdā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Has he, perchance, attained to a realm which is beyond the reach of a created being's perception? or has he concluded a covenant with the Most Gracious?

ayahs.textArabic: كَلَّا ۗسَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُوْلُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهٗ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ مَدًّا ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Kallā, sanaktubu mā yaqūlu wa namuddu lahū minal-‘ażābi maddā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Nay! We shall record what he says, and We shall lengthen the length of his suffering [in the hereafter],

ayahs.textArabic: وَّنَرِثُهٗ مَا يَقُوْلُ وَيَأْتِيْنَا فَرْدًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa nariṡuhū mā yaqūlu wa ya'tīnā fardā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and divest him of all that he is [now] speaking of: for [on Judgment Day] he will appear before Us in a lonely state.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اٰلِهَةً لِّيَكُوْنُوْا لَهُمْ عِزًّا ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wattakhażū min dūnillāhi ālihatal liyakūnū lahum ‘izzā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: For [such as] these have taken to worshipping deities other than God, hoping that they would be a [source of] strength for them.

ayahs.textArabic: كَلَّا ۗسَيَكْفُرُوْنَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُوْنُوْنَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Kallā, sayakfurūna bi‘ibādatihim wa yakūnūna ‘alaihim ḍiddā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: But nay! [On Judgment Day] these [very objects of adoration] will disavow the worship that was paid to them, and will turn against those [who had worshipped them]!

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّآ اَرْسَلْنَا الشَّيٰطِيْنَ عَلَى الْكٰفِرِيْنَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ اَزًّا ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Alam tara annā arsalnasy-syayāṭīna ‘alal-kāfirīna ta'uzzuhum azzā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: ART THOU NOT aware that We have let loose all [manner of] satanic forces upon those who deny the truth - [forces] that impel them [towards sin] with strong impulsion?

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْۗ اِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Falā ta‘jal ‘alaihim, innamā na‘uddu lahum ‘addā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, be not in haste [to call down God's punishment] upon them: for We but number the number of their days.

ayahs.textArabic: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ اِلَى الرَّحْمٰنِ وَفْدًا
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma naḥsyurul-muttaqīna ilar-raḥmāni wafdā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: On the Day when We shall gather the Godconscious unto [Us,] the Most Gracious, as honoured guests,

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَسُوْقُ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ اِلٰى جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا ۘ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa nasūqul-mujrimīna ilā jahannama wirdā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and drive those who were lost in sin unto hell as a thirsty herd is driven to a well –

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يَمْلِكُوْنَ الشَّفَاعَةَ اِلَّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ الرَّحْمٰنِ عَهْدًا ۘ
ayahs.textLatin: Lā yamlikūnasy-syafā‘ata illā manittakhaża ‘indar-raḥmāni ‘ahdā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [on that Day] none will have [the benefit of] intercession unless he has [in his lifetime] entered into a bond with the Most Gracious.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَلَدًا ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qāluttakhażar-raḥmānu waladā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: As it is, some assert, "The Most Gracious has taken unto Himself a son„!

ayahs.textArabic: لَقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا اِدًّا ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Laqad ji'tum syai'an iddā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Indeed, [by this assertion] you have brought forth something monstrous,

ayahs.textArabic: تَكَادُ السَّمٰوٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنْشَقُّ الْاَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ الْجِبَالُ هَدًّا ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Takādus-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna  minhu wa tansyaqqul-arḍu wa takhirrul-jibālu haddā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: whereat the heavens might well-nigh be rent into fragments, and the earth be split asunder, and the mountains fall down in ruins!

ayahs.textArabic: اَنْ دَعَوْا لِلرَّحْمٰنِ وَلَدًا ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: An da‘au lir-raḥmāni waladā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: That men. should ascribe a son to the Most Gracious,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا يَنْۢبَغِيْ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ اَنْ يَّتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā yambagī lir-raḥmāni ay yattakhiża waladā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: although it is inconceivable that the Most Gracious should take unto Himself a son!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنْ كُلُّ مَنْ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ اِلَّآ اٰتِى الرَّحْمٰنِ عَبْدًا ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: In kullu man fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi illā ātir-raḥmāni ‘abdā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Not one of all [the beings] that are in the heavens or on earth appears before the Most Gracious other than as a servant:

ayahs.textArabic: لَقَدْ اَحْصٰىهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Laqad aḥṣāhum wa ‘addahum ‘addā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: indeed, He has full cognizance of them, and has numbered them with [unfailing] numbering;

ayahs.textArabic: وَكُلُّهُمْ اٰتِيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa kulluhum ātīhi yaumal-qiyāmati fardā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and every one of them will appear before Him on Resurrection Day in a lonely state.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمٰنُ وُدًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti sayaj‘alu lahumur-raḥmānu wuddā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: VERILY, those who attain to faith and do righteous deeds will the Most Gracious endow with love:

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ وَتُنْذِرَ بِهٖ قَوْمًا لُّدًّا
ayahs.textLatin: Fa innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika litubasysyira bihil-muttaqīna wa tunżira bihī qaumal luddā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and only to this end have We made this [divine writ] easy to understand, in thine own tongue, [O Prophet,] so that thou might convey thereby a glad tiding to the God-conscious, and warn thereby those who are given to [futile] contention:

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِّنْ قَرْنٍۗ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُمْ مِّنْ اَحَدٍ اَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa kam ahlaknā qablahum min qarn(in), hal tuḥissu minhum min aḥadin au tasma‘u lahum rikzā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, how many a generation have We destroyed before their time - [and] canst thou perceive any one of them [now], or hear any whisper of them?
